classification: CLI argument validation and repository-setting dispatch
rationale: Retain all nine concrete visibility rows through real argument parsing, validation and dispatch: they prove exact repo.update payloads, selector preservation, show/hide/inherit storage mapping and rejection before RPC.

cases.title: sets $visibility for $repo without changing other fields
cases.reason: Four rows exercise show/hide/inherit and opaque ID, spaced name, Windows path and POSIX path selectors; exact update payload forbids unrelated field changes and JSON output preserves the response.

parameter_inputs.expression: { visibility: 'inherit', stored: null, repo: String.raw`path:C:\Repos\My repo` }

cases.title: rejects $args before calling the runtime
cases.reason: Five rows distinguish omitted visibility, valueless flag, empty value, missing repo and invalid enum; each requires invalid_argument guidance and no runtime call.

classification: CLI session-search adapter, output and mixed-version transport policy
rationale: Retain all sixteen declarations and four flag rows; use a checked RuntimeClient fixture and existing success-envelope builder, independently require invalid_argument and recovery guidance for malformed cursors, and remove redundant serialized equality after deep equality. Supported-agent expectations prove adapter forwarding only, not registry completeness.

cases.title: sends the query with the contract defaults the schema resolves
cases.reason: Real adapter resolves query/default limit and forwards supported-agent negotiation fields in the exact search RPC payload; this is wiring coverage, not an independent registry inventory.

cases.title: sends %s
cases.reason: All four scope/freshness, paging, repeated-filter and debug rows execute parsing into concrete RPC parameters; filters also require status negotiation before search.

cases.title: calls the status RPC for --index-status
cases.reason: Index-status mode must select the distinct status RPC and format the returned current phase.

cases.title: renders a result page as text
cases.reason: Independent full text expectation checks actual result formatting, evidence, local resume command, paging cursor and count/duration.

cases.title: renders a disabled index as an answer
cases.reason: A disabled service response must become the user-facing disabled answer.

cases.title: renders a stale cursor as guidance to re-run without one
cases.reason: A stale-cursor response must produce recovery guidance to repeat the search without the cursor.

cases.title: raises a malformed cursor through the CLI error channel
cases.reason: Require invalid_argument and independent recovery guidance, replacing comparison to an imported production message constant; a wrong-code mutation passes the original and fails this reviewed case.

cases.title: answers a host with no such method as unavailable rather than a raw error
cases.reason: Explicit method_not_found from an older host becomes a no-service answer through the real shared adapter.

cases.title: answers an old host asked for status with the absent-service sentinel
cases.reason: An older host missing the status method must synthesize disabled/idle status output.

cases.title: propagates a transport failure instead of calling it unavailable
cases.reason: A runtime_unavailable transport failure must propagate rather than be mistaken for unsupported search service.

cases.title: applies the paired-client exposure policy for a remote runtime
cases.reason: Remote runtime JSON must redact the source path and resume command through the real transport exposure policy.

cases.title: keeps the local resume command and source path for a same-machine host
cases.reason: The local transport control must preserve source path and resume command.

cases.title: hands back the contract response unchanged under the CLI envelope
cases.reason: Keep independent envelope-key and full result deep equality; remove JSON.stringify equality that duplicates the same decoded result assertion.

cases.title: drops the debug block the caller did not ask for
cases.reason: Injected host debug data must be removed when the caller did not request debug.

cases.title: keeps the debug block the caller asked for
cases.reason: Explicit debug must preserve the host debug block through schema parsing and output.

cases.title: hands back the status response unchanged
cases.reason: JSON index-status mode must preserve the full status result under the printed envelope.
